stats.text:
As a {ref:glossary/magic} action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape and cause spectral trees and vines to appear in a 15-foot Cube on the ground within 120 feet of yourself. They last there for 1 minute or until you have the {ref:condition/incapacitated} condition or die. You and your allies have Half Cover while in that area, and your allies gain the current {ref:glossary/resistance} of your Nature's Ward while there.

As a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}, you can move the Cube up to 60 feet to ground within 120 feet of yourself.
